findings.description: The function appends non‑negative values immediately, then raises ValueError on a negative value. If a negative value appears after some positive values, those positive values remain in store, violating the contract that the store must be unchanged when any negative value is present.
findings.evidence: Example: store=[1]; append_batch(store, [2, -3]) results in store=[1,2] after exception, whereas the contract requires store to remain [1].

review.summary: append_batch fails to maintain atomicity when encountering a negative value after some non‑negative values have already been appended.
